news.words: McVay said he didn't have an update on the ankle injury Kupp suffered Sunday but noted, "I just know it didn't look good. It didn't sound good."

news.words: Multiple sources said that after initial testing on Cooper Kupp's ankle, he appears to have avoided a worst-case scenario with the injury. Important to remember, though, that he'll go through more testing in the coming days

news.source: Jourdan Rodrigue, The Athletic, on X
news.words: Kupp's initial X-rays were negative so more likely looking at a high ankle sprain instead of serious fracture or break... Kupp will miss time; what is still being determined is how much.
Rams' WR Cooper Kupp suffered a high ankle sprain Sunday vs. the Cardinals, per one source. Another familiar with his prognosis said it "doesn't sound good."

news.source: FantasyPros (citing Adam Schefter and Jourdan Rodrigue)
news.words: Kupp suffered a high-ankle sprain... He will receive further testing to determine the extent of the injury. A high-ankle sprain would take Kupp out for multiple weeks most likely, but it won't be season-ending.

news.source: Sean McVay, press conference (ESPN, Sarah Barshop)
news.words: Kupp will have ankle surgery Wednesday and be placed on injured reserve... McVay did not rule the receiver out for the rest of the season. The "tightrope" procedure typically has a recovery time of five to six weeks.

Kupp is expected to miss six to eight weeks after undergoing surgery this past week for a high ankle sprain... if Los Angeles' struggles continue, Kupp would not be likely to play again until the 2023 season.
Cooper Kupp is expected to miss six to eight weeks after surgery for a high right ankle sprain... The timeline does not favor a return in 2022 unless the Rams quickly turn around their season.
